generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP Portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
Materials like bitumen, steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should get tested by the quality control authority before use on the work.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labor welfare fund.

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original, Submit the original document at the time of technical bid opening or next day and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval.

If any, additional information required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, Bangalore Division, BANGALORE during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday, the next working day will be considered.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.
The contractors assessed available tender capacity shall be more than the tender value, it will be calculated as per the STD tender document Attached.
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable.
Tenderer who qualifies in the technical bid such tenderers financial bid will be opened.
Contractor should establish a fully functional laboratory at site at no extra cost in order to carry out all the required tests for the materials being used in the project.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
Contractor should carryout additional test required to test the suitability of materials before using the same to the work.

Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum, the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost. Contractor should execute the project with least impact to the environment.

When Structure constructed disputes arising on account of damages to the existing bunds, Structure and other private properties, if any, has to be resolved by the contractor. All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public /private properties.
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.

The Bidder shall not furnish any fake/fabricated/false information or withhold facts etc., if the bidder is found to have violated any of these above (found either during evaluation or after awarding the tender), the tender shall be rejected and action as per rules and regulations shall be taken against the Bidder.

If the Successful Bidder has quoted lesser rates than the estimated rates then he should without fail remit the Unbalanced Tender Amount along with the Security Deposit within the stipulated time as that shall be specified in the Letter of Acceptance, failing which the tender of the Successful Bidder shall be rejected.

All the items of work as Maintained in the Bill of Quantity (BOQ) are including lead and lift charges loading and unloading charges labour charges all incidental charges hire charges of all machinery and equipment required for successful completion of work etc., complete. The work shall be executed as per standard technical specification and directions of Engineer in charge of the work.
Terms and condition of Contract as per Approved STD KW-3

Uploaded original BG or EMD to be submitted to The Executive Engineer, PWD Bangalore Division, Bangalore on or before the last date of receipt of the tender otherwise tender will be rejected for non-submission of EMD
Period of Completion is 03 Months
Contractor shall be Class-III & Above

Progress of Work will be reviewed monthly / at the end of each Milestone. In case the Progress achieved falls short by more than 10% of the Cumulative Programmed, the Reasons for such Shortfall shall be examined and a Record made thereof apportioning the Responsibilities for the Delay between the Contractor and the Employer.
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the Contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
The Item rates are Exclusive of GST
The rates should be quoted Exclusive of GST. (As per the GOVT Order FD 417 Exp-12/2024 Dt:09.08.2024.)

Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305.4.3 ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Granular Sub-Base - Plant Mix Method - Construction   of   Granular   Sub-Base   of   required   grading   as per  design  mixing  in  a  mechanical  mix  plant  at  OMC,  carriage of  mixed  Material  to  work  site,  spreading  in  uniform  layers with  motor  grader  on  prepared  surface  and  compacting  with vibratory power roller to achieve the desired density, complete as per clause 401 - For Grading -V Material. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 401 ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406 ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Prime Coat over WMM/WBM - Providing  and  applying  primer  coat  with  SS1  grade  Bitumen Emulsion   on   prepared   surface   of   granular   base   including cleaning of road surface and spraying primer at the rate of 0.70 kg/m2  using mechanical means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 502 ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Tack coat on Granular surface treated with primer - Providing  and  applying  tack  coat  with  VG-10  Bitumen  using pressure  distributor  at  the  rate  of  0.25    kg/m2    on  Granular Surface. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 503 ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Bituminous Macadam Grading - II for traffic <20 MSA - Providing  and  laying  Bituminous  Macadam  with  40/60  TPH capacity    hot  mix  plant  using  crushed  aggregates  of  specified grading  premixed  with  bituminous  binder  VG-30  @  3.4%  by weight of mix, transported to site, laid over a previously prepared surface  with  mechanical  paver  finisher  to  the  required  grade, level and alignment and rolled as per clauses 501.6 and 501.7 to achieve the desired compaction. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 504 ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete - Providing  and  laying  Semi  Dense  Bituminous  Concrete  with 40/60  TPH  capacity   hot  mix  plant  batch  type  using  crushed aggregates of specified grading premixed with bituminous binder VG-30  @  5%  by  weight  of  mix  and  filler,  transported  to  site, laid over a previously prepared surface with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment and rolled as per MoRTH V revision. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - IRC-37:2018 ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade-II with type B Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70kg per m² over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification". 2 (Common SCHEDULE OF RATES FOR ROAD AND BRIDGE WORKS 2023 - 2024 Vol-3 P.No:93, I. No.10.15 (ii)) (1st Corrigenda for Vol 1, 2 and 3 Schedule of Rates W.e.f. 05-02-2024) ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

itemList.description: Road Marking with Hot Applied Thermoplastic Compound with Reflectorising Glass Beads on Bituminous Surface - Providing  and  laying  of  hot  applied  thermoplastic compound 2.5 mm thick including reflectorising glass beads @ 250 g/m2 area, thickness of 2.5 mm is exclusive of surface applied glass beads  as  per  IRC:35:2015.The  finished  surface  to  be  level, uniform and free from streaks and holes. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 803 ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Bituminous Macadam Grading - II for traffic <20 MSA - Providing  and  laying  Bituminous  Macadam  with  40/60  TPH capacity    hot  mix  plant  using  crushed  aggregates  of  specified grading  premixed  with  bituminous  binder  VG-30  @  3.4%  by weight of mix, transported to site, laid over a previously prepared surface  with  mechanical  paver  finisher  to  the  required  grade, level and alignment and rolled as per clauses 501.6 and 501.7 to achieve the desired compaction. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 504 ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work
